purpose: Execute the unchanged bounded constrained successor after v1 produced zero sampled or scientific information and terminated solely because of an outcome-blind launcher syntax defect.

v1_terminal_record.v2_legitimacy: V1 observed only a deterministic exact score of the inherited initialization, already implied by the frozen design calibration. It sampled no constrained action and exposed no seed-dependent, reward, candidate, or arm-comparison information. V2 cannot be outcome-tuned from information that does not exist.

changes_from_v1: fresh smoke seed 9701 and exogenous offsets

constrained_policy.behavior_logprob: exact renormalized four-choice categorical at the unique divergent token
constrained_policy.trainer_logprob_policy: The live smoke must show both trace and packed-batch behavior logprobs agree with the exact constrained categorical within 0.02 nats; otherwise C5 terminates before SFT.
constrained_policy.target_policy: The target digit policy remains unconstrained and byte-identical to v4.
constrained_policy.symmetry_rule: Every scientific arm, training rollout, branch replay, exact support scorer, and held-out evaluator uses the same four-route policy definition.
constrained_policy.surrogate_mismatch_disposition: No shared-surrogate approximation is accepted. A trace or packed-batch logprob mismatch is a terminal feasibility failure.

constrained_rescore.interpretation: design calibration only; not a scientific result

checks: Every context request carries exactly the four frozen route choices.
Every root completion is exactly one canonical route.
The generated route-label token matches the exact scorer token ID.
Every trace behavior logprob agrees with the exact renormalized categorical within 0.02 nats.
Every packed trainer-batch root choice logprob agrees with the same categorical within 0.02 nats.
constrained_interface_smoke.failure_handling: Terminate C5 without SFT, scientific arms, retry, or fallback.

initialization.selection_training_model: Merge the inherited Stage C2 adapter into the named base in BF16, then train one new LoRA from that deployed initialization.
initialization.v1_artifact_reuse: Do not reuse v1's remote model or score artifacts; its pod was destroyed. Reconstruct from the byte-identical inherited adapter.

factorized_dataset.policy: Reuse the byte-identical reward-blind factorized corpus. It shapes independent marginals and never joint reward structure.

sft.one_run_rule: After the first C5 live model call, do not rerun the smoke; after the first SFT optimizer step, do not rerun SFT or train replacement candidates.

candidate_selection.rule: Select the earliest ascending optimizer checkpoint satisfying every unchanged v4 threshold under constrained root semantics; later checkpoints are not consulted.

authoritative_scoring.model_form: BF16 merged model, never runtime-LoRA scores
authoritative_scoring.engine: Pinned vLLM installation and campaign model-loading mode
authoritative_scoring.route_policy: Exact constrained categorical recovered at the unique divergent choice token.

candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate: Invoke the terminal stopping rule, recover compact evidence, and launch no scientific campaign.

terminal_stopping_rule.trigger: No C5 candidate satisfies every unchanged threshold.
terminal_stopping_rule.forbidden_next_step: No C6 or other replacement initialization design may be launched.
allowed_dispositions: Run one separately preregistered, explicitly underpowered exploratory campaign at the measured support.
Stop live experiments and write the systems and CPU results.
terminal_stopping_rule.decision_timing: Frozen before the first C5 live model call to prevent sunk-cost-driven gate redesign.

scientific_campaign_if_selected.freeze_condition: The selected adapter bytes, hash, exact constrained support report, smoke report, terminal selection report, and a new scientific campaign preregistration must be committed locally first.
scientific_campaign_if_selected.factorial_rule: The constrained route policy and shared warm start are identical in broadcast and sliced arms; exploration is not bundled into ReDCO.
primary_outcomes: policy calls to the frozen causal-action threshold
scientific_campaign_if_selected.reporting_rule: Report both primary outcomes separately, including any Pareto tradeoff. Do not create a post-hoc weighted verdict.

execution.launcher_runtime_regression: Invoke scripts/run_stage_c2_campaign_arm.sh through Bash, require a nonzero missing-arguments exit, and reject any 'bad substitution' output before provisioning.
execution.failure_handling: After the first live model call, any smoke failure is terminal. After the first SFT optimizer step, any failure is terminal. Recover compact artifacts and do not retry.
execution.local_artifact_policy: Retain exact scores, signed verifications, manifests, logs, reports, and only a selected adapter. Store terminal evidence in a compressed archive.
execution.teardown: Always terminate compute after artifact recovery and confirm zero persistent disks.

hardware.resource_pin_rule: Before provisioning, commit a hardware-only amendment naming the exact eligible resource ID, provider, location, and rate.
hardware.ssh_rule: Verify SSH noninteractively immediately after provisioning; terminate without model calls if it fails.
